usage: The normal way to introduce yourself: ismi followed directly by your name, with no verb in between. It is the same for men and women. In formal introductions it usually follows a greeting and is answered with tasharrafna.

variants.label: with the pronoun
variants.note: Adds a little emphasis, as when answering "and you?".

variants.label: simplest
variants.note: Just "I am" plus your name; fine in any setting.

variants.label: literary
variants.note: Found in books and formal speech, rarely said aloud.

variants.label: for forms and officials
variants.note: Use when giving your name for paperwork.

examples.english: My name is Sarah, and I am from Canada.
Hello, my name is Youssef. What is your name?
My name is Layla and I work as a teacher.
